title: Frontend: Read More
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Read More. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({content="",limit=3}). Collapse to the first limit whitespace-separated words joined by one space and append … only when truncated. Read more/Show less toggles full original content. Use [data-testid="content"], and hide toggle when short.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Derive the excerpt from immutable full text and store only whether it is expanded.
alternativeApproaches: Preserve a stable focus target and selection when switching between excerpt and full text.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Short text; exact limit; long text.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
